summary: Master procurement analytics to improve spend visibility, supplier reporting, and sourcing decisions through practical, hands-on exercises.
lede: Procurement analytics and spend intelligence turn purchasing data into evidence for sourcing and supplier decisions. Designed for professionals who work with procurement data or supplier reporting, the course covers cleaning and classifying spend, building spend cubes, measuring supplier performance and contract compliance, and creating KPI dashboards. It also introduces forecasting, supplier risk indicators, and sourcing scenario analysis.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already touch procurement data, supplier reporting, or category performance and need a more structured way to turn that information into insight. Procurement Analysts who cleanse and classify spend data. Category Managers who review savings and supplier concentration. Sourcing Specialists who support award decisions with analytics. Procurement Controllers who reconcile reporting and compliance metrics. Supplier Relationship Managers who track supplier scorecards. Procurement Operations Leads who govern reporting workflows. Supply Chain Finance Analysts who validate spend and savings. Strategic Sourcing Managers who build category business cases. AP Data Specialists who extract and normalize transaction records. Commercial Managers who monitor contract leakage and value delivery.
prerequisites: You need a laptop, Microsoft Excel or a comparable spreadsheet tool, and access to sample procurement or spend data for exercises. A Power BI environment is useful for dashboard practice, but the course can still be completed with spreadsheet-based analysis if BI access is limited.
